subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should OpenClaw core own six fixed bilingual session-mark presets and a permanent `markLanguage` session field, or should session marking remain an optional plugin/generalized tagging capability?
rationale: The patch adds a new core command and persisted session contract for an optional workflow, while repository policy favors plugins for optional capability and no linked issue or maintainer discussion confirms this specific preset and localization design.

options.title: Prefer an extension path
options.body: Keep fixed presets and localization outside core, using existing plugin command/session-action surfaces and proposing only a generic missing UI or label-mutation seam if required.

options.title: Sponsor a core contract
options.body: Explicitly approve core ownership, then require structured mark provenance, complete session lifecycle persistence, generalized localization semantics, upgrade coverage, and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Prefer an extension path
recommendation.body: Keep fixed presets and localization outside core, using existing plugin command/session-action surfaces and proposing only a generic missing UI or label-mutation seam if required.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core product scope and the session lifecycle currently maintained in the central session-state path.
